# printmd

> Free online Markdown to PDF converter. Edit, style, and print Markdown instantly in your browser.

## What is printmd?

printmd is a free, browser-based tool that converts Markdown files to beautifully styled PDFs. No signup, no file upload to servers — everything runs client-side.

## Key Features

- Real-time Markdown editor with live preview
- 5 theme presets (GitHub, Notion, Academic, Minimal, Dark)
- Instant PDF export and print
- Custom CSS styling
- Drag & drop file import
- PWA support (works offline)
- Chrome extension for GitHub README conversion
- Multilingual (English, Korean)

## URLs

- Homepage: https://printmd.app
- Markdown to PDF: https://printmd.app/en/markdown-to-pdf
- Print Markdown: https://printmd.app/en/markdown-print
- Markdown Editor: https://printmd.app/en/markdown-editor
- Markdown Guide: https://printmd.app/en/guide
- Full documentation for LLMs: https://printmd.app/llms-full.txt

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript
- Editor: CodeMirror 6
- Renderer: markdown-it
- All processing happens client-side in the browser
- No server-side data storage
